 Appearance:
 Mr P P Majmudar(5284) for the Applicant(s) No. 1
 Mr. Bhargav Pandya, Ld. Addl. Public Prosecutor for the
 Respondent(s) No. 1
 ==========================================================
 Coram:Honourable Mr. Justice Divyesh A. Joshi
 Date : 08/04/2025
 Oral Order
1. Rule returnable forthwith.
Mr. Pandya, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent No.1-State of Gujarat.
Mr. Keval Dholakiya, the learned advocate, has entered appearance on behalf of the respondent No.2-original complainant and waives service of notice of rule.

2. By this application under section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the petitioner seeks to invoke the inherent powers of this court, praying for quashing of the first information report being C.R. No.I-85 of 2018 lodged before the Bavla Police Station, Ahmedabad Rural of the offence punishable under sections 376, 312, 323, 427, 504, 114 and 506() of the IPC as well as Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(w), 3(2)(5)(a) and 3(2)(5) of the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 on the ground that NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/16476/2024 ORDER DATED: 08/04/2025 undefined there has been an amicable Moidalam Abdulnabikha Pathan vs State Of Gujarat on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155295854/
1 settlement between the parties and the respondent No.2-original complainant is no longer desirous of prosecuting the first information report further.

sentences.text: The respondent No.2-Renukaben D/o. Manubhai Keshubhai Rathod is personally present and she confirms about the settlement arrived at with the accused person.
The respondent No.2- Renukaben D/o.
Manubhai Keshubhai Rathod is identified by her learned advocate Mr. Keval Dholakiya.
Smt. Renukaben D/o.

Manubhai Keshubhai Rathod has also filed an affidavit, inter alia, stating as under:
"I, Renukaben D/o. Manubhai Keshubhai Rathod. Female.

aged about 34 years,
Indian inhabitant, having address at 4-218 Vankar Vas, Dhanwada, Dist:A'bad does hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as under:
1.

I state that I am the original complainant in the FIR being C.R. No. 1-85 of 2018 registered with Bavla Police Station, Dist. Ahmedabad Rural for the offence punishable under sections 376, 312, 323, 427, 504, 114 and 506(1) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 as well as Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(w), 3(2)(5)(a) and 3(2)(5) of the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

entities.text: Bavla Police Station, Dist. Ahmedabad Rural
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. I state that now the matter is amicably being settled with the petitioner and thus,
now no grievances are left against the petitioner and therefore, now I have no objection if the FIR being C.R. No.I-85 of 2018 registered with Bavla Police Station,
Ahmedabad Rural is quashed and set aside, and so in the interest of justice, the FIR may be quashed and set aside.
3. I state that the present compromise is arrived without any coercion, force or undue influence and I have no grievance against the petitioner if the captioned Special Criminal Application is allowed.
Solemnly affirmed at Ahmedabad on this 9 th day of NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/16476/2024 ORDER DATED: 08/04/2025 undefined December, 2024."
3. Taking into consideration the nature of the dispute and the fact that the parties have now amicably decided to live peacefully, no useful purpose would be served to allow the police to continue with the investigation of the said first information report.
4.
In the result, this application is allowed.
The first information report being C.R. No.I-85 of 2018 lodged before the Bavla Police Station, Ahmedabad Rural
is hereby ordered to be quashed.
All consequential proceedings arising from the same also stands terminated.
Rule is made absolute.
The Registry shall accept the Vakalatnama of Mr. Keval Dholakiya, the learned advocate appearing on behalf of the respondent No.2.
Direct service is permitted.

(DIVYESH A. JOSHI,J) VAHID Moidalam Abdulnabikha Pathan vs State Of Gujarat on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155295854/
